zigbee2mqtt.title: Zigbee2MQTT Configuration
zigbee2mqtt.description: ZigSight receives Zigbee2MQTT messages through Home Assistant's MQTT integration, so no broker settings are needed here. Enter the Zigbee2MQTT base topic (`mqtt.base_topic` in the Zigbee2MQTT configuration).

error.invalid_topic_prefix: Invalid base topic. Use a plain MQTT topic without wildcards, e.g. `zigbee2mqtt`.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance of ZigSight is allowed
abort.mqtt_not_available: The MQTT integration is not set up. Set up Home Assistant's MQTT integration (connected to the broker Zigbee2MQTT uses) first, then add ZigSight again.
abort.zha_not_available: The ZHA integration is not set up. Set up ZHA first, then add ZigSight again.

recommend_channel.name: Recommend Zigbee channel
recommend_channel.description: Analyzes Wi-Fi interference and recommends the best Zigbee channel

wifi_scan_data.name: Wi-Fi Scan Data
wifi_scan_data.description: JSON data from Wi-Fi scan (optional if using router API mode)

mode.name: Scan Mode
mode.description: How to obtain Wi-Fi scan data

enable_zha_diagnostic_entities.name: Enable ZHA diagnostic entities
enable_zha_diagnostic_entities.description: Enables the LQI and RSSI diagnostic sensors of ZHA devices that are still disabled by their default. Never re-enables an entity a user disabled themselves. Home Assistant reloads the ZHA config entry afterwards to create the newly enabled entities, which can take a few seconds.

zha_diagnostics_disabled.title: ZHA LQI/RSSI sensors are disabled
zha_diagnostics_disabled.description: ZigSight found {count} ZHA link quality (LQI) / RSSI diagnostic sensor(s) still disabled by default. Call the `zigsight.enable_zha_diagnostic_entities` service (Developer Tools > Actions) to enable them; Home Assistant reloads the ZHA integration afterwards to create the entities, which can take a few seconds.
